dsh-bloub-mood 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。动态心情图标：favicon、侧栏字标与首页标题随会话状态切换 bloub 表情动画（执行中 / 等输入 / 完成 / 空闲），8 种形状、12 种颜色与自定义文字均可在设置页配置。

posts.en:
dsh-bloub-mood is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Animated mood icon: swaps the favicon, sidebar wordmark and hero headline for bloub expression animations that follow session state (working / awaiting input / done / idle), with 8 shapes, 12 colors and custom wordmark texts configurable in Settings.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5371f6a1372670ffb4da.html
